profileEvidence.summary: Lively and cheerful, the Ratonero Murciano is sociable with familiar people and strongly attached to its owner. It can be energetic and determined while watching the household, then peaceful and self-assured at rest. This small rural dog was used against vermin in Murcia’s granaries; local breed work has sought to preserve the scattered population as the region’s economy changed.
